name: muapi-interior-design
tagline_zh: 拍一张旧房间，AI 秒变高级样板间；还能凭空生成新户型，或把某件家具的风格“搬”进你家——连光影都真实。
tagline_en: Snap a room, get a pro redesign; conjure new layouts or drop a furniture style into your space—with realistic.
desc_en: Create professional interior design visualizations — redesign existing rooms, generate new room concepts, or visualize specific furniture styles in a space.
why_zh: 不是滤镜，是理解空间结构后重绘；支持改造、生成、家具风格三合一，且输出带真实光影。
why_en: Not a filter—it understands spatial structure to redraw; combines redesign, generation, and furniture style with realistic.
